implementation_hints.hint:
<phase="2-thread-list-ui
        Update threads list to show sorted by updatedAt
        
          
async getThreadsSortedByUpdate(projectId: string): Promise<ThreadRecord[]> {
  const threads = await this.db.threads
    .where('projectId')
    .equals(projectId)
    .sortBy('updatedAt');
  return threads.reverse(); // Most recent first
}

<phase="3-scroll-restoration
        Animate to saved scroll position
        
          
function restoreScrollPosition(element: HTMLElement, targetPosition: number) {
  const startPosition = element.scrollTop;
  const duration = 300;
  const startTime = performance.now();

  function animate(currentTime: number) {
    const elapsed = currentTime - startTime;
    const progress = Math.min(elapsed / duration, 1);
    // Ease out cubic
    const ease = 1 - Math.pow(1 - progress, 3);
    element.scrollTop = startPosition + (targetPosition - startPosition) * ease;

    if (progress < 1) {
      requestAnimationFrame(animate);
    }
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(animate);
}
